title: Agora Rotary Dial Phone
tagline: Call a real-time AI character from an interactive 3D rotary telephone.
description: Create a tactile Three.js rotary phone that starts an Agora Conversational AI call after the user dials, with RTC audio, optional RTM status updates, signed call tickets, and resilient cleanup.
author: zicojiao

media.title: Agora Rotary Dial Phone
media.summary: Dial into a 3D escape room and talk to an AI character. See how voice can become part of the experience.
media.thumbnailAlt: The public Rotary Dial Phone demo, a Chinese 3D escape room with a telephone and safe
